beginner.headline: Weather and air travel
beginner.brief: Air travel faces hotter weather and more storms. Climate change may cause more disruption to journeys. Passengers might face more delays. Some planes might need to change their routes.

intermediate.headline: Weather and air travel
intermediate.brief: Air travel faces hotter conditions and stormier skies as the climate changes. The report asks whether passengers will increasingly have to accept disruption. That disruption may include delays. Some planes might need to change their routes.

advanced.headline: Weather and air travel
advanced.brief: The report considers whether a changing climate will mean more disruption for aviation. Its headline points to hotter conditions and stormier skies. Delays and diversions are presented as problems passengers may increasingly have to accept, rather than a prediction about every flight. Some planes might need to change their routes.
